figures.caption: The first row after the unsigned byte load. Two native Debug views show the same first-iteration stop.

figures.caption: The first row after eight reversal iterations, before storing the reversed byte. Three native Debug views share this stop.
figures.alt: Four annotated IDE details at row_reversed. The next instruction is sb t8 zero s1. Original register t3 is hexadecimal 16, reversed accumulator t8 is 68, and remaining iteration count t4 is zero. The original binary row 00010110 reverses to 01101000.

figures.caption: After drawing one original row and its mirror. Two native Debug views share the stop before advancing the row pointers.

Across the first display row, the left eight cells are 00010110 and the right eight are 01101000, where one means white. The remaining seven display rows are black.

figures.caption: Both eight-row images after the outer loop finishes. Two native Debug views show the completed frame and stored row bytes.
figures.alt: Three annotated IDE details at done, before li v0 ten. The 16-column eight-row display has the original image on the left and its horizontal mirror on the right. Memory at 10010200 contains the unchanged frame canary, all eight source bytes and the first four reversed bytes. The next memory row starts with the last four reversed bytes followed by the unchanged rows canary.
